description: Run the SRE OpenSearch search-threadpool-rejected case workflow. Creates or updates an Observability case in the sre space, gathers CloudWatch AWS/ES evidence, classifies RCA, and pauses for human approval before any cancel. Required inputs: domain, node. Optional: account, region. Does not call AWS UpdateDomainConfig. Live cancel_long_searches only if the domain is opted in on sre-os-domain-endpoints.
